description:
Create a targeted promotional landing page for 'Pro Series' equipment using Drupal Views.

Goal: Build a page at URL path '/pro-audio' that lists relevant products.

Requirements:
1. Create a new View named 'Pro Audio Sale' showing 'Commerce Products'.
2. Create a Page display with the path '/pro-audio'.
3. Configure filters so ONLY products with 'Pro' in the title appear (e.g., AirPods Pro, Galaxy Buds2 Pro). Ensure the standard 'Published' filter is also kept.
4. Add a Global Text Area to the View Header with the text: 'Upgrade your setup with our professional gear.'
5. Add a Menu Link for this page to the Main Navigation with the title 'Pro Audio'.

The Drupal admin credentials are admin / Admin1234! and the site is at http://localhost.

metadata.expected_header_text: Upgrade your setup with our professional gear
